headline: Justice minister orders a review of the police investigation into a girl's kidnapping
deck: Nicolai Wammen says the police cannot fully account for parts of the case; experienced investigators will go through it.
standard: Nicolai Wammen, the justice minister, will set up a special group of experienced investigators to review the police investigation in the Kirkerup case, the kidnapping of a 13-year-old girl in 2023. Investigators from NSK, the National Unit for Special Crime, will take part. Wammen announced the review on Friday in a statement to the Folketing, Denmark's parliament, after a police report raised new questions about the investigation.

The report shows that 'on some of the criticisms raised, the police cannot fully account for what happened', Wammen told Berlingske. Parts of the investigation 'could have been handled differently, faster and better', he said.
short: Nicolai Wammen, the justice minister, will have a special group of experienced investigators review the police investigation into the kidnapping of a 13-year-old girl in 2023, after a police report raised new questions. Parts of it 'could have been handled differently, faster and better', Wammen told Berlingske.
